_about: Codenames for soldiers extracted to Graceland, made of a first and a second word chosen by the core's seeded generator; the three units, in order Intel, R&D, Support; and the grades from lowest to highest. `thanks` are what an extracted soldier radios when he lands at Graceland, glad to be out: {} is his new codename. He chose this; the base he left was the one he hated. Every word was checked for slurs and for anything that reads as servitude; a saved recruit whose name uses a word no longer here is renamed when the save loads.
